answer: A seat hangs off a utility meter whose readings the utility signs. It registers a meter number at one street address; each epoch the utility publishes fifteen-minute kWh intervals under its own key, and the verifier fits that curve to the work claimed. A draw that never moves fails. Two seats behind one meter share a load shape, so the ledger folds them into one vote, each forfeiting 70,000 POA. A thousand seats need a thousand connections: $180,000 in deposits, $9,000 monthly in charges. Yarrow roots in a hand's width of soil over the karst, each stalk drinking from its own horizon.
